PULSAR_ADVERTISED_ADDRESS.description: Host the broker advertises to clients (what pulsar://:6650 and pulsar+ws://:9091 point at). Defaults to the public domain for external access; set to the private domain to keep same-project traffic off the internet.

PULSAR_DATA.description: Pulsar data directory (BookKeeper ledgers + ZooKeeper/managed-metadata) on the attached persistent volume.
